subject: SIG initiation & evidence pathways — follow-up from demo
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Zhang <claire.zhang@novusplatform.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 08 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG initiation & evidence pathways — follow-up from demo

Hi Claire —

Thanks again for the time today — great to see where Novus is headed. Per our demo and the brief security conversation with Matt, I wanted to capture a short, practical plan to kick off the vendor security questionnaire work so we can keep your procurement timeline intact.

High-level asks we had from the call:
- Confirm whether Novus will accept a CAIQ + SOC 2 summary (preferred for speed) or requires a custom SIG variant.
- SOC 2 status: date of last audit, public report availability, and any scoped exclusions.
- Regulated data: does Novus expect HIPAA applicability for the integration (PHI flows)?
- KMS / key management: do you require customer-managed keys / external HSM integration?
- Hosting / residency constraints: any EU/data‑sovereignty controls we should map now?

Proposed evidence paths (pick one):
1) CAIQ-first (fast path): we prefill the CAIQ, you provide SOC 2 summary + any custom questions — target: 7–10 business days to handoff evidence bundle.
2) Custom SIG-lite (if you have unique controls): we run SIG-lite + 1-hour walkthrough, capture screenshots and config evidence — target: 10–15 business days.

I attached a lightweight SIG prefill template that we typically return filled with our standard evidence links (redwood_SIG_prefill_template.xlsx). If you can tell me which path you prefer, I’ll loop in Marissa to own evidence collection and schedule the technical walkthrough with Karthik.

Next steps I suggest:
- Confirm preferred evidence path (CAIQ or custom) — reply here.
- Share SOC 2 summary (PDF or link) and the right security POC at Novus (name + email).
- If HIPAA applies, flag that explicitly so we include compliance evidence and BAAs in the timeline.

Happy to jump on a 20-minute call with Matt and your security lead if that makes coordination easier. My Calendly: https://calendly.com/jonas-web/20

Thanks —
Jonas Weber
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0163

--
Attachment: redwood_SIG_prefill_template.xlsx (Excel - prefill template)
Attachment: SOC2-summary-2025.pdf (PDF - redacted executive summary)

From: Claire Zhang <claire.zhang@novusplatform.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Matt Evans <matt.evans@novusplatform.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Jun 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG initiation & evidence pathways — follow-up from demo

Jonas —

Thanks for the clear recap and the template. Quick answers from our side:
- We are open to the CAIQ-first path — it’s our preferred route to speed things along. We do have a few custom data-handling questions that we may add on top of the CAIQ.
- SOC 2 status: last audit completed March 2025, we have an executive summary and standard SOC report redaction available. I’ll attach the summary in a follow-up message (we need to confirm internal permissions first).
- HIPAA: our integration will ingest user-provided healthcare notes for a subset of customers, so this is in-scope — we will need to confirm BAA terms.
- KMS: we do not require customer-managed keys for this initiative but want to understand key rotation policies and encryption-at-rest details.
- Residency: all production data is in the US for now, EU residency is possible later but not required for this contract.

Point of contact for security: Matt Evans (matt.evans@novusplatform.com) — he’s on cc. He’ll own the SOC 2 and legal conversations.

We prefer to aim for the CAIQ-first path. Can you confirm what a 7–10 business day timeline looks like for you (start date assuming we share the SOC 2 summary tomorrow)? Also, is there a standard BAA template Redwood uses or should we expect to exchange drafts?

Thanks,
Claire Zhang
Head of Product Partnerships | Novus Platform
claire.zhang@novusplatform.com

--
Attachment: (will send SOC2-summary-2025.pdf after internal approval)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Zhang <claire.zhang@novusplatform.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Matt Evans <matt.evans@novusplatform.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Jun 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG initiation & evidence pathways — follow-up from demo

Claire / Matt —

Great — CAIQ-first it is. A few clarifying items so Marissa and I can kick immediately once we have the SOC summary:

Questions for Novus security team (short):
- Can you confirm the SOC 2 report scope (systems in-scope and any excluded subservice orgs)? This helps us map controls quickly.
- For HIPAA: do you expect Redwood to sign a BAA ahead of a POC or post-POC? We can provide our standard BAA for review — typically legal prefers to exchange drafts early.
- For encryption: a one-paragraph summary of key rotation, KMS provider (AWS KMS / GCP KMS / Azure Key Vault), and whether any keys are customer-managed.

Proposed immediate plan (week 0):
- Day 0: Novus shares SOC 2 summary + confirmation of CAIQ additions (you can mark a handful of custom questions).
- Day 1–3: Redwood pre-fills CAIQ, maps evidence links (we use a combination of internal docs and redacted artifacts).
- Day 4–7: Quick 45-min evidence walkthrough with Novus security (screenshare), confirm items we still need.
- Target handoff: end of week 2 with a deliverable evidence bundle for your procurement/legal.

Marissa will own the CAIQ prefill and the evidence bundle; Karthik will join the technical walkthrough to answer ops/config questions. I’ve attached the prefill template again and a sample SOC 2 executive summary we use for redactions.

Marissa — can you take lead on scheduling? Claire / Matt — what times next week work for a 45-min walkthrough? I can propose Tue/Wed morning PT.

Thanks —
Jonas

--
